verdict.rationale: Postman's evidence pack covers API client, testing, mocking, collaboration, and CLI features, plus a narrow 'Fabric Gateway' used only to register MCP servers for AI agents — not a general-purpose traffic gateway. There is no evidence of production request routing, load balancing, or payload transformation between arbitrary consumers and upstream services. Missing for 10: any documentation of gateway-style routing rules, load-balancing algorithms, or request/response transformation pipelines for live traffic between consumers and upstream services.
